notes.title: HOTFIX Error executable application
notes.content:
We apologize for the error, we have fix the issue for the game launch where HR Simulator couldn’t launch due to a missing executable file, which has now been fixed.

I really appreciate your patience and understanding while this was being resolved. If you still experience any issues, please try verifying your game files or reinstalling — and feel free to let us know here.

Thank you again for your support, and I hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.55
notes.content:
[h3]📣 Hello, HR Enthusiasts![/h3]
Thank you for all your valuable feedback — it's been incredibly helpful!
Based on your input, we’ve continued developing and improving HR Simulator. Check out the latest updates and fixes below:


✅Added a Walk Indicator — now you can see where Ummu is heading!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45316840/1bec8019d78ff40e26089e792712130fd630fd95.gif[/img]

✅Added a Quality Settings feature.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45316840/cd7b5956225bacf46efde4c85fdbe8c9288c4a21.gif[/img]

✅Added a Windowed Mode Settings feature.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45316840/17da1110a2277d58121ef2a385e729fa0e3d71a5.gif[/img]


🔧 Additional Update:
[list]
[*] Resolved multiple UI-related bugs and glitches.
[*] Balanced gameplay: outing now costs $200.
[*] Revised in-game dialogues for better grammar (EN only)
[*] Added WASD Movement support for keyboard users.
[*] Improved object interaction timing.
[*] Darkened company report text for better readability.
[*] Adjusted notification container design.
[*] Polished the settings UI in the main menu.
[*] Tutorial updated: you can now click outside the dialogue box.
[*] Home activity now gives +1 mood; outing gives +2 mood.
[/list]

🛠️ Additional Fixes & Stability Improvements
[list]
[*] Fixed soft lock issue occurring after the interview event.
[*] Fixed afternoon time slot text alignment on loading screen.
[*] Added condition to disable WASD movement to prevent null reference errors.
[*] Added null return in camera aspect ratio handler for better error handling.
[*] Fixed translation consistency across the system.
[*] Fixed Training Minigame bug where VFX remained at 0 seconds.
[*] Fixed oversized “No” button container in the main menu.
[*] Fixed incorrect employee CV photos and grammar issues in dialogues.
[*] Fixed the Training Minigame timer system not working as intended.
[*] Fixed Time Slot Sync After Interview & Candidate
[*] Fixed Bula Minigame SFX Bug
[/list]


💼 Whether you're training employees or managing a hectic day, we’re making sure your HR journey runs smoother than ever!
👉 Update now and let us know what you think — your feedback helps shape the future of HR Simulator!

notes.title: HR Simulator is Out NOW!!
notes.content:
We're so excited to finally welcome you to the world of HR Simulator. It's been a wild four months of development, and today you can officially jump into Early Access!

Over the past four months, our small indie team has poured everything into building this quirky, heartfelt workplace adventure. What started as a passion project is now ready for you to experience — a mix of narrative choices, strategic HR gameplay, charming characters, and immersive environments.

We’re incredibly grateful for your support during development. From everyone who played the demo, shared feedback, or just cheered us on — thank you. Your encouragement helped us push through every obstacle.

We hope you enjoy playing as much as we enjoyed creating it.

💬 If you encounter bugs, have suggestions, or want to share your thoughts — please join the discussions. We’re actively listening and ready to improve throughout Early Access.

Here’s to the first day on the job. Let’s build something great together. 💜

notes.title: March+April 2025 Dev Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 👋

As we approach our Early Access release on April 14th, we wanted to share a behind-the-scenes look at what we’ve been working on over the past two months. Our small indie team has been pushing hard to bring HR Simulator to life — improving core systems, polishing visuals, and enhancing the overall gameplay experience.

[h3]System[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increase office timeslot from 3 to 4 
[*] Fixed Various UI, Interaction Bug, Animation, Mood issues
[*] Improved Loading and Transition Systems
[*] Enhancing Tutorial System for better OnBoarding
[*] Implementing Item Interaction 
[*]Optimized build settings
[*]Revised Character 60 Character data (CV's, Dialogues, Job titles)
[*]Implementing Volumetric lights for night mode
[*]Implementing Mood +1 after going to toilet
[*] Updateing Tutorial Map
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Renewed interview system 
[*] Adjusting employee Productivity, Stress, and Training mechanics
[*] Fixed issues with hiring and firing sequences
[*] Added new Special Characters 
[*] Added calculator minigame on training sections
[*] Added cooking minigame for night time
[*] New Email and Cover letters Dialogue=
[/list]
 
[h3]Visual[/h3]
[list]
[*] Imported new character animations and refined Sitting position animation
[*] Added 4 new loading screens 
[*] New special characters
[*] Enhancing UI Elements
[*] Adjusting Office scale 
[*] Implementing Special Character Animation fort interview result (Accepted/ Rejected)
[*] Implemented New UI for Ummu's mood
[/list]

Sound
[list]
[*] Enhancing Footstep SFX
[*] Adding Training Minigame BGM
[*] Adding Employee Stats SFX
[/list]

We’re incredibly grateful for your continued support and patience. Your encouragement keeps us going, and we can’t wait for you to jump into the game this April 14th!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Dear players and supporters, 

After four challenging months of developing HR Simulator, we've made the tough decision to shift our release date to [b]April 14th[/b]. While we truly wanted to launch on march 14th, we need more time to polish and refine the game to ensure the best possible experience for you. We sincerely apologize for the delay and appreciate your understanding.

We know this may be disappointing, and we feel the same. But while you wait, we're working hard to bring you an even better game, featuring [b]Brand-new Characters[/b], [b]Variety of fun Minigames[/b], [b]Completely revamped Interview System[/b]. 

We're also fixing bugs and fine-tuning every detail to make sure everything runs smoothly.
Your support means everything to us, and we promise HR Simulator will be worth the wait.
